name: A/B testing
description: The arm a browser draws and keeps, the routes that create a Variant and end a test, and the read that tells two arms' numbers apart.
_bundle_marker_note: A token that appears in this module's BUILT JavaScript and never in free's. bin/check-loader.mjs scans free's loader for it the way it scans for a premium rule identifier, and it exists because this is the first module to ship loader code while declaring no rule type at all — so the identifier scan, which reads its list out of the rule manifest, had nothing of this module's to look for. `.variant` is the payload key the module reads, minified to a property access and unmistakable in 9 KB of one-line JavaScript.
